title: Quiet space, easy commute
description:
🛏️ Private Upstairs Suite

• Full bedroom + dedicated full bathroom

•Smart TV, desk, and ample closet space

• BeautyRest mattress + blackout curtains

🏡 Shared Amenities

•Main-level living, kitchen, and dining areas

•Balcony for fresh air and city views

• Lower-level workout area

🚗 Prime Location

• Quick drive to airport

• Fast commute to downtown Nashville

📅 Flexible Stays

• Available for short-term bookings

• Ideal for extended stays (travel nurses, relocations, remote work)

The space
My home is a tri-level townhouse, with the guest bedroom and bathroom on the third level. The living room, kitchen, dinning room, and laundry take up the 2nd level. The workout area is located on the entry level.

Guest access
Entire home besides garage and host room.

During your stay
I live her full time, but I’m quiet, easy going, and friendly.

Other things to note
I have two cats who live here with me. They have open access to the entire house besides guests room/bathroom.
